sourceRefs.locator: Carmina XI.19, Latin text, translation, recipient and historical context: milk and other delicacies, a doctor’s orders and the closing greeting.
Introduction and “Playing the crowd”, “Beyond the gates”, “Reaching east”: Fortunatus and Baudonivia, the donations (Vita I.12–13), the Rule and communal gifts, and the eastern mission (Vita II.16).

summary.de: Der Dichter war mit Agnes und Radegunde befreundet. Er schrieb Briefe in Versen und nach Radegundes Tod eine Lebensbeschreibung.
summary.en: A poet and friend of Agnes and Radegund. He wrote verse letters and, after Radegund’s death, an account of her life.
